name: PAX Gold
oneLiner: PAXG is Paxos's centralized gold token backed by allocated London Good Delivery gold held with Brink's and ICBC Standard Bank under OCC trust supervision.
collateral: LBMA Good Delivery physical gold bars allocated in LBMA-approved Brink's Global Services and ICBC Standard Bank vaults; each token represents one fine troy ounce; insured against theft and loss; bankruptcy-remote custody under Paxos Trust Company
pegMechanism: Each PAXG represents one fine troy ounce of allocated London Good Delivery gold. Verified Paxos customers may convert to USD at a short-lived market quote or redeem allocated gold, with a minimum 430 PAXG per bar. Effective September 1, 2026, the public destruction-fee schedule charges rolling 30-day net redemptions marginally at 0.125%, 0.250%, 0.350% and 0.500%, plus 0.05% for in-kind gold conversion; delivery, bank charges and controlling private pricing supplements remain separate. Monthly independent KPMG examinations reconcile redemption assets and redeemable tokens.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: PAXG is a direct allocated-commodity claim: the current Pax Gold terms make holders beneficial and fractional owners of allocated London Good Delivery bars held through the federally regulated Paxos trust structure, and KPMG's May 29, 2026 report independently reconciles 467,075 redeemable tokens to 467,075 fine troy ounces while naming Brink's Global Services and ICBC Standard Bank as the LBMA-approved vault providers. Migrated to commodity-claim under methodology v9.14; fiat-cash was only ever the nearest available issuer-reserve category.
